question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
WITH cause_counts AS (
    SELECT ci.db_year, c.primary_collision_factor, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM case_ids ci
    JOIN collisions c ON ci.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL AND c.primary_collision_factor != ''
    GROUP BY ci.db_year, c.primary_collision_factor
),
top2_per_year AS (
    SELECT db_year, primary_collision_factor, cnt, rn
    FROM cause_counts
    WHERE rn <= 2
),
year_cause_list AS (
    SELECT db_year, GROUP_CONCAT(primary_collision_factor, ',') as causes
    FROM top2_per_year
    GROUP BY db_year
)
SELECT db_year, causes
FROM year_cause_list
ORDER BY db_year
